statement.text:
Let X be a closed simply connected smooth 4-manifold and let $\Sigma$ be a closed, orientable surface. Fix a smooth embedding of $f: \Sigma \hookrightarrow X$ to serve as a basepoint. For which $k\geq 0$ does the equality
$$
\ker i_{*}=\ker s_{*}
$$
 hold, where
$$
\begin{aligned} i_{*}&:\pi_{k}(\operatorname{Emb}^{DIFF}(\Sigma,X^{\circ});f)\to \pi_{k}(\operatorname{Emb}^{TOP}(\Sigma,X^{\circ});f),\\ s_{*}&:\pi_{k}(\operatorname{Emb}^{DIFF}(\Sigma,X^{\circ});f)\to \operatorname*{colim}_{N\to\infty}\pi_{k}(\operatorname{Emb}^{DIFF}(\Sigma,X^{\circ}\#_{N}S^{2}\times S^{2});f). \end{aligned}
$$
 Here $i_*$ is induced by inclusion and $s_*$ by stabilization. To make sense of this for k=0, define $keri_{*}$ and $kers_{*}$ to be the preimages under $i_{*}$ and $s_{*}$ respectively of [f].
